name: lmnts
description: Plan, draft and schedule a client's social content in lmnts from ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription: Connect your lmnts account and ChatGPT can work inside your workspace: list your clients and the platforms each has connected, create and edit draft posts and tasks, upload images and video, set per platform schedules and Instagram or TikTok options, read and leave comments, and hand instructions to Sprk, the lmnts assistant. Everything stays a draft until a person reviews it in lmnts. Approving and scheduling is a separate permission you choose to grant when you connect.
interface.defaultPrompt: List my lmnts clients and which platforms each one has connected.
